title: SemDHT: Certified Semantic Discovery for Peer-to-Peer Agent Networks over Exact-Key DHTs
abstract: arXiv:2609.23539v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents may need capabilities exposed through external agent endpoints or service APIs. When a requester is not already bound to a provider, it must discover advertised capabilities matching its task and interface requirements. Over exact-key distributed hash tables (DHTs), broad retrieval transfers large candidate lists, whereas selective retrieval may miss relevant providers or require more replication and lookups. Open publication also lets providers inflate their exposure unless publication bounds are enforceable. We present SemDHT, a certified semantic index for discovering agent-accessible capabilities over exact-key DHTs. A two-layer semantic sketch uses coarse cells to group nearby descriptors and residual codes to narrow candidate selection. translated_title: SemDHT：基于精确键分布式哈希表的对等代理网络认证语义发现
translated_abstract: 代理可能需要通过外部代理端点或服务API所暴露的能力。当请求方尚未与某个提供方绑定时，它必须发现与其任务和接口要求相匹配的已发布能力。在精确键分布式哈希表（DHT）上，宽泛的检索会传输庞大的候选列表，而选择性的检索则可能漏掉相关提供方，或者需要更多的复制与查找操作。此外，开放式发布还允许提供方夸大其曝光度，除非发布上限是可强制执行的。我们提出了SemDHT，一种用于在精确键DHT上发现代理可访问能力的认证语义索引。该方法采用双层语义草图：利用粗粒度单元对相近的描述符进行分组，并使用残差码来缩小候选选择范围。提供方在一组有界的派生键上进行发布，而请求方则在查找预算内先探测精度键，再探测更广泛的召回键。锚定委员会对每个描述符的发布进行认证……
tldr: 本文提出SemDHT，通过双层语义草图、有界派生键发布与锚定委员会认证机制，在精确键DHT之上实现了对等代理网络中高效且可信的代理能力语义发现。
en_tdlr: SemDHT introduces a certified semantic index over exact-key DHTs that combines a two-layer semantic sketch, bounded derived-key publication, and anchor committee certification to enable efficient and trustworthy discovery of agent capabilities in peer-to-peer agent networks.
